# Lovable → Emergent Migrator

> Analyze a Lovable-synced GitHub repo and generate everything needed to import it into Emergent.

Site: https://lovable-emergent-migrator.space.fast/
Docs: https://lovable-emergent-migrator.space.fast/docs.html
FAQ: https://lovable-emergent-migrator.space.fast/#faq
Source: https://github.com/Mike-Demo/lovable-emergent-migrator (MIT)
Skill: npx skills add mike-demo/lovable-emergent-migrator

## What it does

1. User pastes the URL of the GitHub repo Lovable created via Settings → Git → Connect GitHub.
2. The analyzer (100% client-side, only calls api.github.com) inventories the repo:
   framework and key dependencies from package.json, supabase/ migrations and edge
   functions, env var names referenced in code, secret patterns, tracked .env files,
   .lovable/ builder artifacts.
3. It generates a migration pack: a paste-ready EMERGENT.md prompt for Emergent's
   agent, a .env.example (names only), and an acceptance checklist saved in
   localStorage per repo.

## Import path into Emergent (UI only — Emergent has no import API)

Profile icon → Connect GitHub → new task → GitHub button in chat → Pull from GitHub
→ pick repo + branch → paste the EMERGENT.md prompt as the first agent message.

## Backend decision

Emergent's native stack is FastAPI + MongoDB; Lovable apps are Vite + React +
Supabase. The default path keeps Supabase as the backend (lowest risk). If no
supabase/ directory is found, the prompt tells the agent to identify the real
backend and ask for its URL/keys rather than invent one.

## What travels / what doesn't

Travels: React source, package.json, supabase/migrations (schema + RLS),
supabase/functions (edge functions), public assets, git history.
Stays behind: database rows (zero data in exports), Storage bucket files,
secrets (re-enter in Emergent), Lovable hosting/preview URLs/analytics.

## Other interfaces

- CLI: migrate-to-emergent.sh --repo <git-url> [--branch emergent-import] [--push]
  Clones locally, same inventory, commits an emergent-import branch.
- MCP server (stdio, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk): tools analyze_repo and
  generate_migration_pack. Per-call github_token or GITHUB_TOKEN env.
- Agent skill: skills/lovable-emergent-migrator/ in the repo; install via
  npx skills add mike-demo/lovable-emergent-migrator.

## Privacy

Web analysis is client-side only. GitHub tokens are kept in page memory, never
stored or sent anywhere except api.github.com.
